svg.title: Bindweed in a summer garden
svg.desc: Field bindweed, Convolvulus arvensis, twines up a dry grass stalk in a quiet dacha garden outside Moscow. Pale trumpet flowers open one after another with the morning light and fold closed again. Birches lean in from the edges, an old grey fence rests behind, and chamomile, cornflowers and dandelion clocks stand in the grass while dandelion seeds drift past.
